correctness.rationale: Exact stationary equations of the 16-state process give J=(u-v)P/D and E=-4d²F/(D(U,V)D(V,U)). Positivity of D on the physical reservoir square is certified by coefficient absorption. The nine-degree transformed polynomial H has negative top four coefficients; the remaining six coefficients have one ordered contrast zero each, proved by transformed-polynomial Descartes sign counts and exact rational brackets. These imply exactly one positive t root for all d<dc and none at/above dc except the lower endpoint at dc; direct exact rational computation settles d=1. Standalone verify.py reconstructs the full certificate and compares a separately coded exact-Fraction stationary calculation on five rational pairs. Domain and quantifiers: all d in (0,1], all admissible rho. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A bounded reservoir-density window is the natural physical control at fixed bias, and sign reversals determine which direction of imposed gradient transports more strongly. The exact unique density threshold for every subcritical contrast and an algebraically sharp high-contrast extinction point form a complete nontrivial two-parameter phase classification of a minimal but physically motivated disordered system. This is not merely an additional tabulated point or a single arbitrary slice: the proof establishes global root uniqueness and the qualitative phase topology through six ordered coefficient transitions.
